subject.title: fix(markdown-core): CJK-friendly emphasis flanking so **标签：**正文 renders bold (#101120)

question: Should OpenClaw accept markdown-it-cjk-friendly as a new runtime dependency for this shared parser fix, or require a dependency-free implementation instead?
rationale: The maintained plugin is a cleaner fix shape, but this external PR adds a runtime dependency and lockfile delta that OpenClaw's dependency guard blocks until admin/security approves the exact head, and the current branch also needs cleanup before any merge.

options.title: Clean branch plus dependency authorization
options.body: Keep the maintained plugin approach, rebuild the branch to only the markdown fix, then have an authorized admin/security reviewer approve the dependency graph for the cleaned head.

options.title: Use a dependency-free parser patch
options.body: Reject the dependency graph change and ask for or apply a narrow inline delimiter-scan fix with the same regression coverage.

options.title: Replace with the sibling PR
options.body: Close or supersede this PR only after choosing a viable cleaned replacement such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101229 and preserving the useful tests/proof.

recommendation.title: Clean branch plus dependency authorization
recommendation.body: Keep the maintained plugin approach, rebuild the branch to only the markdown fix, then have an authorized admin/security reviewer approve the dependency graph for the cleaned head.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and authored the current dependency-plugin refactor commits, so they are the clearest owner for the dependency/security-boundary choice.
